name: gift-card
summary: A photo gift card that tilts toward your finger and flips to reveal its code.
props: Who sent it and who it's for.
Redeem code, revealed on the back (grouped in fours).
Shows a Copy button — wire it to expo-clipboard.
Card art — a photo or texture (require() or { uri }).
Light text for dark art, dark text for pale art.
Dim the card with a Redeemed label.

behavior: Tap the card to flip it over to the redeem code. The copy button calls onCopy and reads "Copied ✓" for a moment.
With tilt on (the default) the card leans toward your finger with a moving reflection, then turns over in 3D on a spring.
The card is a button labelled with the brand, amount and redeemed state; the code is added to the label once it is flipped.
